extraction.Name: Anna Blackbird
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 716639 issued under the 'Declaration of Policy.' Application for patent in fee signed by Anna Blackbird before E. E. Empey, Notary Public, on April 18, 1918. Letter written by Superintendent E. E. McKean, Rosebud, South Dakota, February 5, 1929, referencing Circular 2464, letter of December 11, 1928, and Office letter of January 5, 1929.
